views.name: volunteer_attendance_evidence
views.definition:
SELECT p.outing_id,
    r.volunteer_id,
    p.id AS report_id,
    p.lead_name,
    p.starts,
    p.ends,
    p.observations,
    p.submitted_at,
    bool_or((member.value -> 'attended'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) AS attended,
    bool_or((member.value -> 'attended'::text) = 'false'::jsonb) AS absent,
    jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'version', md5(p.updated_at::text || p.participants::text), 'attended', bool_or((member.value -> 'attended'::text) = 'true'::jsonb), 'absent', bool_or((member.value -> 'attended'::text) = 'false'::jsonb)) AS evidence_entry
   FROM outing_reports p
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.participants) member(value)
     JOIN registrations r ON r.id::text = (member.value ->> 'id'::text) AND r.outing_id = p.outing_id
  WHERE p.status = 'finalizado'::text
  GROUP BY p.outing_id, r.volunteer_id, p.id;

functions.name: attendance_resolution_is_current
functions.arguments: decision text, reviewed jsonb, current_evidence jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION __schema__.attendance_resolution_is_current(decision text, reviewed jsonb, current_evidence jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select decision in ('participo','no_participo','pendiente') and reviewed is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(reviewed) old
    where not coalesce(current_evidence,'[]'::jsonb) @> jsonb_build_array(old)
  ) and not exists (
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(current_evidence,'[]'::jsonb)) fresh
    where not reviewed @> jsonb_build_array(fresh)
      and (decision='pendiente' or
        (decision='participo' and (fresh->>'attended' is distinct from 'true' or fresh->>'absent' is distinct from 'false')) or
        (decision='no_participo' and (fresh->>'attended' is distinct from 'false' or fresh->>'absent' is distinct from 'true')))
  )
$function$
